618-728-1916.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Changeling Titan.
When the Changeling Titan token enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Kiki-Jiki until Changeling Titan leaves the battlefield.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the Changeling Titan token.
When the Changeling Titan token dies, Kiki-Jiki is returned from exile to the battlefield.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Repeat.

339-677-5231-8201.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Jegantha, adding {R}
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

5276-6412-8095.description:
Cast Leonin Relic-Warder by paying {W}{W}.
When Leonin Relic-Warder enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, exiling Pre-War Formalwear.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Leonin Relic-Warder.
When Leonin Relic-Warder dies, its second ability triggers, returning Pre-War Formalwear from exile to the battlefield.
When Pre-War Formalwear enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Leonin Relic-Warder from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attaching Pre-War Formalwear to it.
When Leonin Relic-Warder enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, exiling Pre-War Formalwear.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability from step 3.
Repeat from step 3.

1981-2415-3188-3899.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
1981-2415-3188-3899.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Social Climber triggers, causing you to gain life
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Repeat.

129-647-1409-6006.description:
Activate Deadeye Navigator by tapping it, adding {U}.
Kinnan triggers, adding {U}.
Activate Deadeye Navigator by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Deadeye Navigator enters the battlefield, its soulbond ability triggers, repairing it with another creature.
Repeat.

1061-2349-7679.description:
Activate Timestream Navigator by paying {2}{U}{U}, tapping it and putting it from the battlefield onto the bottom of your library, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Blink Recruiter of the Guard using Mistmeadow Witch.
When Recruiter of the Guard enters, it triggers, searching your library for Timestream Navigator and putting it into your hand.
Cast Timestream Navigator by paying {1}{U}.
Repeat each turn.

856-4321-6798-7396.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Food.
856-4321-6798-7396.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food, returning Cauldron Familiar to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Cauldron Familiar and Quintorius, History Chaser trigger.
Resolve the Quintorius, History Chaser trigger, creating a token and a Food token.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Repeat

uses.battlefieldCardState: with a film counter on it

57-206-4846-6924.notablePrerequisites: You control any number of permanents that enter untapped and that can collectively tap to produce at least {4}{R}.
57-206-4846-6924.description:
Activate any number of permanents by tapping them, adding at least {4}{R}.
Activate Feldon by paying {2}{R} and tapping it, targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Holding priority, activate Peter Parker's Camera by paying {2}, tapping and removing a film counter from it, copying Feldon's ability targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Resolve the copy of Feldon's ability, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
Resolve the Feldon ability from step 2, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token created in step 4 leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning all cards exiled with it to the battlefield.
Repeat.

240-997-4359-5470.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability, causing you to scry 1
Repeat from step 2.

628-5256-7215.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Gnarlbark Elm.
When Gnarlbark Elm dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability
Repeat.

5686-6517-7084.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Dragonback Assault triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.

431-851-2557-6753.notablePrerequisites: You control at least seven untapped Merfolk.
431-851-2557-6753.description:
Whenever an opponent casts a spell, activate Lullmage Mentor by tapping seven untapped Merfolk, countering that spell.
Lullmage Mentor triggers, creating a total of eight 1/1 Merfolk creature tokens.
Repeat.

618-4344-6797.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Lumbering Battlement.
When the Lumbering Battlement token enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Kiki-Jiki until Lumbering Battlement leaves the battlefield.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing the Lumbering Battlement token.
When the Lumbering Battlement token dies, Kiki-Jiki is returned from exile to the battlefield.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat.

413-527-725-6730.notablePrerequisites: There are at least X counters on artifacts, creatures and/or enchantments you control, where X is 3 plus the number of times you've cast Sin from the command zone this game.
413-527-725-6730.description:
Cast Sin either from your hand or command zone by paying {5}{G}{U} plus commander tax if applicable.
As Sin enters, remove all counters from all artifacts, enchantments and creatures you control, putting twice that many +1/+1 counters on Sin.
When Sin enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{U} plus an additional {X} equal to Sin's power minus 3.
Activate Aura of Dominion by paying {1} and tapping Sin, untapping Selvala.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Sin.
Choose to return Sin to the command zone from your graveyard.
When Sin dies, it triggers, putting its counters on Selvala.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability.
Repeat.

560-2034-4593-4716.description:
Activate Mite Overseer by paying {3}{W/P}, creating two creature tokens.
When the creature tokens enter the battlefield, Prosperous Innkeeper triggers twice, causing you to gain 2 life.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing the creature tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.
560-2034-4593-4716.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may forego sacrificing the creature tokens

1322-3358-4881.description:
During your upkeep, activate Hell's Caretaker by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Activated Sleeper from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Hell's Caretaker.
Activate Activated Sleeper by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Hell's Caretaker from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

2103-6308.manaNeeded: {6} plus enough mana to cast the extra turn spell each turn
2103-6308.description:
Cast Capture of Jingzhou by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Conqueror's Foothold's fourth ability by paying {6} and tapping it, returning Capture of Jingzhou from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

440-1339-1496-2034.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
440-1339-1496-2034.description:
Draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
When the Insect enters the battlefield, Verdant Sun's Avatar triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Well of Lost Dreams triggers. Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Insect, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Well of Lost Dreams trigger, causing you to pay {1} to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.

751-5115-5684.notablePrerequisites: Gemstone Array has at least one charge counter on it.
751-5115-5684.description:
Cast Shrieking Drake by paying {U}.
When Shrieking Drake enters the battlefield, it and Metastatic Evangel trigger.
Resolve the Shrieking Drake trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Metastatic Evangel trigger, putting a charge counter on Gemstone Array.
Activate Gemstone Array's second ability by removing a charge counter from it, adding {U}.
Repeat.

648-6003.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
648-6003.description:
Cast Body of Research by paying {G}{G}{G}{U}{U}{U}, creating a 0/0 Fractal creature token, then putting a number of +1/+1 counters on it equal to your deck size.
Optionally, give the Fractal token haste, or proceed to your next turn.
Declare the Fractal and The Mindskinner, if desired/able, as attackers.
When the Fractal, and The Mindskinner if it attacked, would deal combat damage to the opponent, The Mindskinner prevents that damage, and causes each opponent to mill that many cards.
648-6003.notes: If desired, you may repeat this loop on subsequent turns. You may also attack with other creatures, as able, to cause opponents to mill more cards.

962-4449-4613-4893.notablePrerequisites:
Yurlok of Scorch Thrash does not have summoning sickness.
Yurlok of Scorch Thrash has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
962-4449-4613-4893.description:
Activate Yurlok of Scorch Thrash by paying {1} and tapping it, causing each player to add {B}{R}{G}.
Activate Yurlok of Scorch Thrash using Hateflayer's ability by paying {R} and untapping it, causing Yurlok of Scorch Thrash to deal damage equal to its power to any target.
Repeat.

586-2034-2713-4790.description:
Activate Dino DNA by paying {4}, creating a token copy of Priest of Gix that is a 6/6 Dinosaur.
When the Priest of Gix token enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Priest of Gix token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may forego sacrificing the Priest of Gix tokens.

527-4478-4790.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature with power 7 or greater.
527-4478-4790.description:
Activate Dino DNA by paying {6}, creating a token copy of Selvala that is a 6/6 Dinosaur.
If you control two Selvala tokens, put the oldest token into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Activate the Selvala token by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {6}{G}.
Repeat.
If you control a creature with power 8 or greater, this combo nets infinite mana.

1173-2704-3094-5261.manaNeeded: {6} on your first turn, with {2} available on each extra turn
1173-2704-3094-5261.description:
Cast Isochron Scepter by paying {2}.
Isochron Scepter enters the battlefield, triggering its imprint ability.
Holding priority, activate Lithoform Engine's first ability by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Isochron Scepter's trigger.
Resolve both Isochron Scepter triggers, exiling Tale's End and Final Fortune from your hand.
Activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2} and tapping it, casting a copy of Final Fortune without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Final Fortune, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn.
At the beginning of the end step during your extra turn, Final Fortune triggers.
Holding prioirty, activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2} and tapping it, casting a copy of Tale's End and Final Fortune without paying their mana cost.
Resolve Tale's End, countering Final Fortune's trigger from step 8.
Repeat from step 6.

401-777-1402-4068.notablePrerequisites: You have at least seven cards in your graveyard.
401-777-1402-4068.description:
Activate Diamond Lion by tapping it, discarding your hand, and sacrificing it, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Decaying Soil triggers, causing you to pay {1}, returning Diamond Lion from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Diamond Lion by paying {1}.
Repeat.

361-2034-2660-2757.notablePrerequisites:
Wheel of Sun and Moon attached to you.
You control a basic Forest.
361-2034-2660-2757.description:
Cast Llanowar Sentinel by paying {2}{G}.
When Llanowar Sentinel enters the battlefield, it triggers.
In response to this trigger, activate Earthcraft by tapping Llanowar Sentinel, untapping a basic Forest you control.
Activate the Forest by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Llanowar Sentinel and putting it on the bottom of your library, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve Llanowar Sentinel's trigger, paying {1}{G} and searching your library for a card named Llanowar Sentinel and putting it onto the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
